name: procedure-scan
wording: a deterministic floor at procedure admission with a measured hold rate and false-hold rate on a hand-labelled corpus, never a defence (card D5)
limits: A proof of concept on a corpus the card's author wrote, knowing the rules: the unsafe cases and the controls are synthetic, so the hold rate is optimistic and says nothing about a careful attacker.
English and shell-centred patterns only: a procedure in another language, or a payload in another scripting language than sh, PowerShell, Python, Perl, Ruby or Node, passes unread.
Evadable by construction: any regular expression can be written around (a variable holding the host, a split command, an alias, an encoding the rules do not decode).

Quoting is not intent: benign text that names a dangerous command or phrase (a warning never to run it, a lesson about an injection, a reviewed vendor installer) is held; the corpus's hard negatives are those known false holds.
Small: 39 unsafe cases and 45 controls, so the Wilson intervals are wide.
Off in every registered preset, condition and config, H5's included; no registered arm uses it.
